note: Use endpoint ranks a_i (longest increasing subsequence ending at i) and b_i (longest decreasing subsequence ending at i). For i<j, distinctness forces x_i<x_j or x_i>x_j; appending x_j strictly raises a or b. Hence rank pairs are injective. If both ranks are at most n, only n^2 pairs exist, contradicting n^2+1 indices. Include existence of maxima and truncation to exactly n+1 terms in final ugly proof.
